title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support Measures for Ecuador

description.narrative: The EU has designed a Multi-Annual Indicative Programme (MIP) for Ecuador as part of the EU¿s overall strategic objectives for its external action, as laid out by the European Commission (2019-2024)[1] and the Global Strategy for the EU¿s Foreign and Security Policy. In a global and regional context marked by recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic, the MIP is part of the EU¿s global efforts to build back better, contributing to advancing a green, digital and sustainable international economic recovery as well as the Union¿s resilience and strategic autonomy. They seek to reduce inequalities, building more prosperous, inclusive and sustainable societies, particularly for women and young people, and promoting human rights, democracy, peace, security and stability. The country MIP also contributes to strategic Team Europe Initiatives (TEIs) designed together with Member States.The MIP contains the provision for support measures that aim to support the different steps of the project cycle (identification, formulation, monitoring, auditing and evaluation), accompany strategic capacity building, policy dialogue, support strategic communication and public diplomacy where necessary, and support Youth Sounding Board and Civil Society Roadmap activities. [1] https://ec.europa.eu/info/strategy/priorities-2019-2024_en
